body.title: QA-${runId}-发布素材
body.text: 客户说价格比竞品高，预算还没有批。我先确认决策链和内部评审时间，再把方案拆成投入产出摘要，用分阶段验收和分期付款降低首付压力。遇到压价时调整交付范围和付款节奏，不破坏价值锚点，同时提供同行业案例证明溢价部分的交付能力。

await.sql: select status from public.skill_material where skill_id = :skillId order by created_at limit 1

dbExec.sql: INSERT INTO public.experience_grain (id, space_id, source_type, scene_tag, scene_description, expert_thought, standard_script, status, weight, quality_score, helpful_count, unhelpful_count, created_at, embedding) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), :spaceId, 'file_upload', s.tag, '客户在' || s.tag || '场景提出价格、预算或竞品异议，需要先确认决策链再给方案。', '先确认预算与决策人，再用价值锚定和分阶段验收替代直接降价。', '我理解您对预算和价格的顾虑，我们先确认内部评审流程，再按投入产出拆解方案。', 'active', 1.0, 0.9, 0, 0, now(), (SELECT embedding FROM public.experience_grain WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) FROM (VALUES ('价格谈判'),('竞品对比'),('决策链推进'),('预算审批'),('效果保障'),('售后挽回'),('合同条款'),('试用方案'),('客户异议')) AS s(tag)

body.background: 八年企业软件销售，负责华东区大客户
body.knowledgeDomains: ["价格谈判","竞品对比","决策链推进"]

body.message: 客户说价格比竞品高、预算没批，怎么推进？

assertions.sql: select (count(*) >= 10)::text from public.experience_grain where space_id = :spaceId and status = 'active'
select (count(distinct scene_tag) >= 3)::text from public.experience_grain where space_id = :spaceId and status = 'active' and scene_tag is not null and scene_tag <> ''
select count(*) from public.experience_grain where id = any(string_to_array(:grainIds, ',')::uuid[])
select status from public.skill where id = :skillId
